item.title: Assam Breakfast Tea
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: A strong, malty black tea from the Assam region of India, this Breakfast Tea provides a full-bodied flavor that’s ideal for starting the day. Its rich, robust profile pairs well with milk and sugar for a classic breakfast tea experience.
